subject.title: Workspaces: add Living Answers and action forms

question: Should Workspaces ship `builtin:action-form` as a bundled prompt-producing widget under the existing `chat.send` authority?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and well-proven, but adding an agent-authored form that can initiate confirmed prompts is a new shipped interaction model whose permanent product and authorization boundary cannot be inferred from tests or code alone.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded action form
options.body: Accept the bundled capability after the dispatch-error path is surfaced through normal Control UI feedback.

options.title: Land Living Answers only
options.body: Keep ephemeral widgets and operator pinning while removing the action-form surface until a separately approved action contract exists.

options.title: Decline bundled prompt actions
options.body: Keep prompt-producing forms outside the shipped Workspaces plugin and retain Workspaces as a display and composition surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded action form
recommendation.body: Accept the bundled capability after the dispatch-error path is surfaced through normal Control UI feedback.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available product-direction contact from the PR timeline and related Workspaces review context.
